items.title: Cowbell outlines 2027 UK cyber insurance trends and AI-driven risks
items.summary: Cowbell's UK team has released its 2027 predictions, pointing to growing talent demand and new commercial exposures stemming from artificial intelligence.

items.title: Milburn report recommends delaying auto-enrolment age reduction to 2031
items.summary: The Milburn review into UK youth unemployment has recommended that the auto-enrolment age should not fall to 18 until 2031 at the earliest.

items.title: Professional Pensions sets registration deadline for UK Pensions Awards 2027
items.summary: Professional Pensions has announced that registration for the UK Pensions Awards 2027 closes today.

items.title: Suffolk herb producer wins £2.4 million court award after broker policy switch
items.summary: Camstar Herbs Limited has secured damages and costs after a High Court ruling exposed critical business interruption advice failures.

items.title: Zurich Insurance raises Beazley integration revenue and capital forecasts
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group has increased its medium-term revenue and capital synergy expectations following its acquisition of specialty insurer Beazley.

items.title: Insurance Age Broker Expo Bites Episode Five unavailable
items.summary: Insurance Age reported that an episode featuring Acrisure UK's Steve Padley could not load due to technical issues.
